I now have a complete map. Here are my findings.

## Overview

This is a Spring PetClinic REST fork where the owner-creation pipeline is built from OfficeFloor "function" classes under `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/`. Owner identity values (memberId, householdId, identityKey) are derived at create-time and assigned onto the `Owner` entity, then exposed through the generated `OwnerDto` via `OwnerMapper`. The `OwnerDto` type is generated at build time from `src/main/resources/openapi.yml` (package `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto`). There is currently NO `apiVersion`, NO nested `identity` object, NO `schemaVersion`, and NO "version 1" tagging anywhere — the target state for those is defined only in the acceptance test described below.

## 1. Region code derivation (e.g. 'NSW')

- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/PostcodeRange.java` — the pinned region→postcode-range table `REGION_RANGE` (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) at lines 29-32. `regionForPostcode(String postcode)` (lines 62-74) derives a region from a postcode. `isValidForCity` (46-53) validates.
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Locality.java` — the pinned city→region table `CITY_REGION` (Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD) at lines 29-32. `forCity(String)` (43-45) and `forPostcode(String)` (57-60, delegates to `PostcodeRange.regionForPostcode`). `UNKNOWN` constant (27) is the fallback region.

## 2. householdId, identityKey, memberId derivation

- memberId: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerMemberIds.java` — `forOwner(Owner)` (lines 30-35) builds `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>` using `Locality.forPostcode`, `FiscalYear.twoDigitYear`, `hash8` (SHA-256 of telephone+lastName, lines 55-58) and `Luhn.checkDigit`. `deduplicate` (42-52). Assigned by `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignOwnerMemberId.java` (`service`, lines 20-29 → `owner.setMemberId(...)`).
- householdId: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerHouseholds.java` — `id(lastName, postcode)` (lines 27-30, first 12 hex of SHA-256 of `normalizedLastName|postcode`) and `of(Owner)` (33-35). Assigned by `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignOwnerHousehold.java` (`service` line 18-20 → `owner.setHouseholdId(...)`). Consumed by `AssignOwnerHouseholdSize.java` and `AssignOwnerMembershipLevel.java`.
- identityKey: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerIdentities.java` — `key(telephone, email, lastName)` (lines 30-34, SHA-256 hex of `E164telephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)`) and `of(Owner)` (37-39). This one is NOT stored on the entity; it is derived on demand. Used by `RequireUniqueIdentity.java` (lines 28-35) and `FlagOwnerPossibleDuplicate.java` (lines 31-36), and surfaced in the DTO by `OwnerMapper.identityKey` (see #4).
- Entity storage: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java` — fields `memberId` (line 76) and `householdId` (line 79) with getters/setters (192-204). No `identityKey` field (derived-only).
- Primary-identifier indirection: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/OwnerPrimaryIdentifier.java` — `of(Owner)` (lines 21-23) returns `owner.getMemberId()`; the single source used by audit/event emitters.
- Supporting utils: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/Sha256.java`, `Luhn.java`, `Soundex.java`.

## 3. locality and timezone fields (user-facing)

- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Timezone.java` — `REGION_ZONE` region→IANA table (lines 28-31) and `forRegion(String)` (42-44).
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java` — DTO mapping `@Mapping(target="locality"...)` (line 39) → `locality(Owner)` (113-118, returns `Locality.forPostcode(postcode)`); `@Mapping(target="timezone"...)` (line 40) → `timezone(Owner)` (122-127, returns `Timezone.forRegion(locality(owner))`).
- OpenAPI schema: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml` `locality` (2208-2216) and `timezone` (2217-2225).

## 4. Owner response shape / DTO (where memberId, identityKey, householdId appear — need regrouping under nested `identity` + top-level `apiVersion`)

- Schema source of truth: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml` — the `Owner` schema currently declares `memberId` (2149-2154), `householdId` (2161-2166), `identityKey` (2167-2176) all at the TOP level. Also `locality` (2208), `timezone` (2217), `ownerSegment` (2234). There is NO `apiVersion` and NO `identity` object here. `OwnerDto` (Java) is generated from this file into package `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto`.
- Mapping into the DTO: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java` — `toOwnerDto` (line 47) with `@Mapping` for `identityKey` (43), plus method `identityKey(Owner)` (86-91). `memberId` and `householdId` are mapped by MapStruct's automatic name matching from the `Owner` entity fields (no explicit `@Mapping`, no derivation method — they are direct passthroughs). This mapper is the place where a nested `identity` grouping and `apiVersion` constant would be wired.
- Response emitters (send the `OwnerDto`): `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/RespondWithOwnerCreated.java` (lines 12-19), `RespondWithOwner.java` (9-14), and also `RespondWithOwnerUpdated.java` and `ListOwners.java`/`ListOwnersPage.java` in the same package (page DTO built in `OwnerMapper.toOwnerPageDto`, lines 216-224).

## 5. Audit event and its schema version

- Human-readable audit: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AuditOwnerCreated.java` — logs to the `AUDIT` logger `id/memberId/registrationDate/membershipLevel` (`service`, lines 20-25).
- Structured JSON audit event: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/EmitOwnerCreatedEvent.java` (`service` 23-27) emits `OwnerCreatedEvent` JSON to the `AUDIT` logger.
- Event record: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerCreatedEvent.java` — record `{seq, ownerId, memberId, membershipLevel, event}` (line 12), discriminator `EVENT = "OWNER_CREATED"` (line 15). NOTE: there is currently NO `schemaVersion` field on this event — the only version-like field is the `event` discriminator string.
- Sequence source: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerCreatedEventSequence.java` (`next()`, lines 21-23).
- Wiring order: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerCreatedEventSequence.java` is a `@Component`; the create pipeline runs `AuditOwnerCreated` and `EmitOwnerCreatedEvent` after the owner is saved (`SaveOwner.java`). Logger config: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/logback.xml`.

## 6. Owner segment derived region

- `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/OwnerSegment.java` — `forOwner(Owner)` (lines 54-56) → `<TIER>_<AREA>`; `tier` (58-60) uses `MembershipLevel.effective`; `area` (62-64) derives METRO/REGIONAL from `Locality.forPostcode(owner.getPostcode())` vs `Locality.UNKNOWN`. Constants PREMIUM/STANDARD/METRO/REGIONAL/PREMIUM_MIN_LEVEL (30-42).
- Surfaced via `OwnerMapper.ownerSegment` (`@Mapping` line 42, method 103-108) and OpenAPI `ownerSegment` (2234-2242).

## 7. Existing "version 1" algorithm / version tagging for identity derivation

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The owner's honorific title. Optional; one of MR, MRS, MS, DR.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat input for backward
            compatibility; when the structured address fields are supplied it is returned as
            the composed value (normalized addressLine1, plus a single space and the normalized
            addressLine2 when addressLine2 is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address'
            input when supplied. Normalized like 'address' (trimmed, whitespace collapsed,
            upper-cased, street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address (e.g. unit or apartment).
            Normalized like 'addressLine1' and appended to the composed 'address' when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional. When present it must be a valid
            postcode for the owner's city region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099);
            a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner registered. Optional; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth (ISO). Optional; when present the derived ageBand is returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, bypasses the household-duplicate block so this owner can be created even
            though another owner already has the same last name and postcode (i.e. they share a
            household); the new owner is recorded as a declared household member and is not
            flagged as a possible duplicate. Request-only directive; not stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner - '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's title and last name ('DR Who'), or just the last name when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans - the country calling code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: Server-assigned unified identity formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' - the region derived from the postcode, the two-digit fiscal year of the registrationDate, the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone followed by the last name, and a single Luhn (mod 10) check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year (the fiscal year starts on 1 July and is identified by the calendar year in which it ends).
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Deterministic identifier shared by every owner in the same household - the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name followed by '|' and the postcode. Assigned automatically to every owner, so owners with the same last name and postcode share it.
              type: string
              example: '1a2b3c4d5e6f'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                Derived duplicate-detection key - the lower-case hex SHA-256 of
                'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)' (telephone in E.164, email
                lower-cased, last name reduced to its Soundex code; telephone and email empty when
                absent). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identityKey is equal.
              type: string
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created, already shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                Scored from the owner's own fields - starts at 0; add 2 when an email is present;
                add 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0); add 2 for a household of
                3 or more; add 3 for tenure over one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 8
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                Mapped from the owner's membershipPoints - level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3,
                level 3 for 4-5, and level 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's postcode range (NSW 2000-2099,
                VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) - the same REGION that forms the memberId -
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode is absent or in no known range.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's region via the pinned
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane) - absent when the region has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred channel for contacting the owner, derived from the owner's
                own fields - 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>' - TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                the membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'; AREA is 'METRO' when the
                locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, more than 80 owners had
                already been registered on the same day; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, the owner's city already held
                between 40 and 49 owners - approaching the per-city capacity limit of 50;
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The age band derived from the owner's birthDate measured against their
                registrationDate - 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at
                65 or over; absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner carries any risk signal - it is a possible duplicate, its email
                domain is disposable-adjacent (shares a disposable provider's registrable label, so
                subdomains and alternate TLDs count), or its city is over its soft capacity (the
                approaching-capacity warning); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at creation, this owner was not a hard duplicate but shared an
                existing owner's lastName and postcode while having a different telephone;
                otherwise false. A declared household member (created with sharesHousehold) is
                never flagged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one possibly duplicates (same lastName and
                postcode, different telephone); absent when possibleDuplicate is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false; a
                DELETE flags it true while retaining the record, which the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks then ignore.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The owner's honorific title. Optional; one of MR, MRS, MS, DR.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat input for backward
            compatibility; when the structured address fields are supplied it is returned as
            the composed value (normalized addressLine1, plus a single space and the normalized
            addressLine2 when addressLine2 is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address'
            input when supplied. Normalized like 'address' (trimmed, whitespace collapsed,
            upper-cased, street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address (e.g. unit or apartment).
            Normalized like 'addressLine1' and appended to the composed 'address' when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional. When present it must be a valid
            postcode for the owner's city region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099);
            a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner registered. Optional; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth (ISO). Optional; when present the derived ageBand is returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, bypasses the household-duplicate block so this owner can be created even
            though another owner already has the same last name and postcode (i.e. they share a
            household); the new owner is recorded as a declared household member and is not
            flagged as a possible duplicate. Request-only directive; not stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner - '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's title and last name ('DR Who'), or just the last name when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans - the country calling code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: The version of the owner API contract this response conforms to.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/Identity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year (the fiscal year starts on 1 July and is identified by the calendar year in which it ends).
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Deterministic identifier shared by every owner in the same household - the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name followed by '|' and the postcode. Assigned automatically to every owner, so owners with the same last name and postcode share it.
              type: string
              example: '1a2b3c4d5e6f'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                Derived duplicate-detection key - the lower-case hex SHA-256 of
                'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)' (telephone in E.164, email
                lower-cased, last name reduced to its Soundex code; telephone and email empty when
                absent). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identityKey is equal.
              type: string
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created, already shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                Scored from the owner's own fields - starts at 0; add 2 when an email is present;
                add 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0); add 2 for a household of
                3 or more; add 3 for tenure over one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 8
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                Mapped from the owner's membershipPoints - level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3,
                level 3 for 4-5, and level 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's postcode range (NSW 2000-2099,
                VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) - the same REGION that forms the memberId -
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode is absent or in no known range.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's region via the pinned
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane) - absent when the region has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred channel for contacting the owner, derived from the owner's
                own fields - 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>' - TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                the membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'; AREA is 'METRO' when the
                locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, more than 80 owners had
                already been registered on the same day; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, the owner's city already held
                between 40 and 49 owners - approaching the per-city capacity limit of 50;
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The age band derived from the owner's birthDate measured against their
                registrationDate - 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at
                65 or over; absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner carries any risk signal - it is a possible duplicate, its email
                domain is disposable-adjacent (shares a disposable provider's registrable label, so
                subdomains and alternate TLDs count), or its city is over its soft capacity (the
                approaching-capacity warning); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at creation, this owner was not a hard duplicate but shared an
                existing owner's lastName and postcode while having a different telephone;
                otherwise false. A declared household member (created with sharesHousehold) is
                never flagged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one possibly duplicates (same lastName and
                postcode, different telephone); absent when possibleDuplicate is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false; a
                DELETE flags it true while retaining the record, which the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks then ignore.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetPage:

          description: Pets in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:

        page:
          title: Page

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of pets matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetFields:
      title: Pet fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet.
          type: string
          maxLength: 30
          example: Leo
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date

          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2010-09-07'

        type:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetType'
      required:
        - name
        - birthDate
        - type
    Pet:
      title: Pet
      description: A pet.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            ownerId:
              title: Owner ID
              description: The ID of the pet's owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            visits:
              title: Visits
              description: Vet visit bookings for this pet.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Visit'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - id
            - type
            - visits
    VetFields:
      title: VetFields
      description: Editable fields of a veterinarian.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: 'James'
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: 'Carter'
        specialties:
          title: Specialties
          description: The specialties of the vet.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Specialty'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - specialties
    Vet:
      title: Vet
      description: A veterinarian.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the vet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
      required:
        - id
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - specialties
    VisitFields:
      title: Visit fields
      description: Editable fields of a vet visit.
      type: object
      properties:
        date:
          title: Date
          description: The date of the visit.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        description:
          title: Description
          description: The description for the visit.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'rabies shot'
      required:
        - description
    Visit:
      title: Visit
      description: A booking for a vet visit.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VisitFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the visit.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            petId:
              title: Pet ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
            - petId
    PetTypeFields:
      title: PetType fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet type.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet type.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: cat
      required:
        - name
    PetType:
      title: Pet type
      description: A pet type.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetTypeFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet type.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
    User:
      title: User
      description: An user.
      type: object
      properties:
        username:
          title: username
          description: The username
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: john.doe
        password:
          title: Password
          description: The password
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: 1234abc
        enabled:
          title: enabled
          description: Indicates if the user is enabled
          type: boolean
          example: true
        roles:
          title: Roles
          description: The roles of an user
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Role'
      required:
        - username
    Role:
      title: Role
      description: A role.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: name
          description: The role's name
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: admin
      required:
        - name

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The owner's honorific title. Optional; one of MR, MRS, MS, DR.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat input for backward
            compatibility; when the structured address fields are supplied it is returned as
            the composed value (normalized addressLine1, plus a single space and the normalized
            addressLine2 when addressLine2 is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address'
            input when supplied. Normalized like 'address' (trimmed, whitespace collapsed,
            upper-cased, street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address (e.g. unit or apartment).
            Normalized like 'addressLine1' and appended to the composed 'address' when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional. When present it must be a valid
            postcode for the owner's city region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099);
            a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner registered. Optional; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth (ISO). Optional; when present the derived ageBand is returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, bypasses the household-duplicate block so this owner can be created even
            though another owner already has the same last name and postcode (i.e. they share a
            household); the new owner is recorded as a declared household member and is not
            flagged as a possible duplicate. Request-only directive; not stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner - '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's title and last name ('DR Who'), or just the last name when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans - the country calling code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: The version of the owner API contract this response conforms to.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/Identity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year (the fiscal year starts on 1 July and is identified by the calendar year in which it ends).
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created, already shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                Scored from the owner's own fields - starts at 0; add 2 when an email is present;
                add 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0); add 2 for a household of
                3 or more; add 3 for tenure over one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 8
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                Mapped from the owner's membershipPoints - level 1 for 0-1 points, level 2 for 2-3,
                level 3 for 4-5, and level 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's postcode range (NSW 2000-2099,
                VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) - the same REGION that forms the memberId -
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the postcode is absent or in no known range.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's region via the pinned
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane) - absent when the region has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred channel for contacting the owner, derived from the owner's
                own fields - 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>' - TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                the membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'; AREA is 'METRO' when the
                locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, more than 80 owners had
                already been registered on the same day; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, the owner's city already held
                between 40 and 49 owners - approaching the per-city capacity limit of 50;
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The age band derived from the owner's birthDate measured against their
                registrationDate - 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at
                65 or over; absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner carries any risk signal - it is a possible duplicate, its email
                domain is disposable-adjacent (shares a disposable provider's registrable label, so
                subdomains and alternate TLDs count), or its city is over its soft capacity (the
                approaching-capacity warning); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at creation, this owner was not a hard duplicate but shared an
                existing owner's lastName and postcode while having a different telephone;
                otherwise false. A declared household member (created with sharesHousehold) is
                never flagged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one possibly duplicates (same lastName and
                postcode, different telephone); absent when possibleDuplicate is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false; a
                DELETE flags it true while retaining the record, which the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks then ignore.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I released **version 2 of the owner identity**, threading a single "version 2" concept through the identity derivation, the response shape, the audit schema, and the owner segment.

**New single source of truth** — `OwnerIdentityVersion` (`rest/function/owner/`):
- `VERSION = 2` (the contract number) and `TAG = "V2"` (the identifier tag).
- `identifierRegion(postcode)` — the region code used *inside* the identifiers: the plain region (`Locality.forPostcode`) with the `V2` tag mixed in.
- `tagged(preImage)` — mixes the `V2` tag into a hash pre-image.

**Identity derivation** (every identifier now changes; no V1 value can recur):
- `OwnerMemberIds` — REGION is now the V2 region (`NSW` → `NSWV2…`).
